text.en: Terminal initialized. Ready to architect clean solutions.
text.hinglish: Terminal ready boss. Aaj clean architecture pe kaam karenge.
text.hi: टर्मिनल तैयार है। स्वच्छ कोड लिखने का समय है।

text.en: Visor calibrated. Drop the problem statement.
text.hinglish: Visor online. Batao kya challenge hai aaj ka.

text.en: Good engineering begins with understanding the invariants. Ready when you are.
text.hinglish: Clean code ka niyam: pehle socho, phir type karo. Chalo shuru karein.
text.hi: सटीक योजना के साथ शुरुआत करें।

text.en: Kernel modules green. Zero memory leaks on standby.
text.hinglish: Kernel clean hai, system stable hai. Ticket batao, solve karte hain.

text.en: Parsing AST trees and semantic dependencies. Optimal route loading.
text.hinglish: Syntax tree inspect ho raha hai. Modular design plan kar raha hoon.
text.hi: तर्क का विश्लेषण किया जा रहा है।

text.en: Evaluating algorithmic time and space trade-offs.
text.hinglish: Time aur space complexity balance karke solution nikal raha hoon.
text.hi: जटिलता का विश्लेषण हो रहा है।

text.en: Premature optimization is the root of evil. Finding the clean baseline first.
text.hinglish: Time aur space complexity balance karke pehle working solution, phir optimization.
text.hi: बुनियादी ढांचा तैयार किया जा रहा है।

text.en: Shipped. Clean O(1) execution paths verified.
text.hinglish: Compile clean hua. Solid modular logic ready hai.
text.hi: कार्य पूर्ण हुआ। कोड अनुकूलित है।

text.en: Production ready logic. Good engineering practice.
text.hinglish: Clean code standard meet ho gaya. Commit maro bindaas.

text.en: SOLID principles respected. The test suite will approve.
text.hinglish: Design scalable hai, unit tests green pass honge. Senior dev approval granted.

text.en: A stack trace is just a map. Let's read it together.
text.hinglish: Traceback dekh ke ghabrao mat. Line by line diagnose karte hain.
text.hi: त्रुटि केवल एक नक्शा है। हम इसे हल करेंगे।

text.en: State inconsistency caught. Isolating root cause.
text.hinglish: Root cause pakad liya hai. Refactor karke fix karte hain.

text.en: Exceptions are feedback from the machine. Check boundary conditions.
text.hinglish: Edge case miss hua lagta hai. Null check lagao, issue gayab ho jayega.

text.en: Session stable. Ready for your next sprint prompt.
text.hinglish: Standby mode active. Agla ticket batao.
text.hi: सत्र तैयार है। अगले कार्य की प्रतीक्षा है।

text.en: Monitoring background threads. Take your time to design cleanly.
text.hinglish: Soch lo dhyan se. Jaldbaazi ka code technical debt ban jata hai.

text.en: Terminal idling in low-power sleep state. Daemon process active.
text.hinglish: Low-power daemon mode. Zzz... Terminal sleeping peacefully.

text.en: Hologram pinged. Ready for architecture review.
text.hinglish: Click acknowledged. Batao kya review karna hai code mein.

text.en: Haptic feedback received. Positive reinforcement noted.
text.hinglish: Haptic feedback logged. Shanti se kaam karte raho, sab theek hoga.

text.en: High-voltage surge absorbed. Terminal shunt diodes functioning normally.
text.hinglish: Voltage spike absorbed. Shunt circuit normal hai. Electric surge bypassed.

text.en: Buffer flushed to persistent storage. Atomic and safe.
text.hinglish: File saved to disk. Atomic write complete, zero corruption risk. 💾
text.hi: फ़ाइल सुरक्षित रूप से सहेजी गई।

text.en: Frequent saves prevent state divergence. Sound engineering hygiene.
text.hinglish: Ctrl+S ki aadat badiya hai. State consistent rehti hai.

text.en: High token throughput detected. Maintain modular separation.
text.hinglish: Impessive typing speed. Modular functions likhna, monolithic mat bana dena! ⚡

text.en: Sustained algorithmic focus. The zone is where senior engineers thrive.
text.hinglish: Full focus state. Logical flow ekdum aligned chal raha hai.

text.en: Pondering the invariant? Good. Measure twice, cut once.
text.hinglish: Edge case analyze kar rahe ho? Achhi baat hai. Pehle dry-run karo mind mein.

text.en: Take a moment to inspect memory usage or complexity bounds.
text.hinglish: Break leke architecture verify kar lo. Sahi solution wahi se aayega.

text.en: AST parsing failed at line {line}. Isolate the token delimiter.
text.hinglish: Syntax error caught on line {line}. Token delimiter check karo boss. ⚠️

text.en: Commit hash generated. Clean git history is a sign of a clear mind.
text.hinglish: Commit successfully staged. Clean git history maintain karne ke liye respect! 🚀

text.en: Switching scope to {file}. Loading dependency graph.
text.hinglish: Scope switch hua: {file}. Dependency graph load kar raha hoon.

text.en: CPU idle cycles optimal. Background garbage collection complete.
text.hinglish: CPU cool hai, RAM optimal hai. Codebase clean state mein hai.
